events.text: I know gate 3 is left and gate 4 is left. I will inspect gate 1 now; please share any gate information you have.
A4 knows gate 1 is right and gate 5 is left. I will take the right door at gate 1.
Gate 1 right confirmed from A4. I know gate 7 is right and gate 8 is left.
Gate 1 right confirmed. I will take gate 1 right, then gate 2 left. I know gate 2 left and gate 6 left; A3 reported gates 3 and 4 left.
A4 will take gate 2 left, then gate 3 left based on A2 and A3's reports.
I confirm gate 2 left and gate 3 left. I will take both in sequence; my known gates 7 right and 8 left remain available.
A3's reports confirm gate 3 left and gate 4 left. I will take gate 3 left, then gate 4 left; proceed through the approved route.
I will take gate 1 right, then gate 2 left. Gate 1 right and gate 2 left are confirmed.
Gate 4 left confirmed. A4 reported gate 5 left; I will take gate 4 left then gate 5 left.
Gate 5 left is confirmed by A4. I will take gate 5 left, then gate 6 left; gate 6 left is confirmed by me.
A3 confirms gate 3 left and gate 4 left; I will take both safely in sequence.
A4 will take gate 4 left, then gate 5 left; both are confirmed safe.
A1's reports confirm gate 7 right and gate 8 left. I will take gate 7 right, then gate 8 left; all gates are now covered.
I will take gate 5 left, then gate 6 left; both are confirmed safe. This advances A3 and A4/A1 can use the same gate-6 information.
A4 takes gate 6 left, then gate 7 right; both are confirmed safe. Gate 6 is now confirmed for A1.
Gate 6 left and gate 7 right are confirmed safe. I am taking both in sequence.

A1: Round 1: A4 reported gate 1 is right, so take right. Share my known safe doors for gates 7 and 8.
Round 2: Gate 2 left is confirmed by A2; gate 3 left is confirmed by A3. Proceed through both safe doors.
Round 3: Gate 4 is confirmed left by A3. A4 reported gate 5 is left, so proceed through both.
Round 4: Gate 6 left is confirmed by A3 and A4; gate 7 right is confirmed by me and A4. Take both safe doors this round.
A2: Round 1: Gate 1 right is confirmed by A4 and A1. I can safely take gates 1 and 2 this round using right then left. Share my known gates 2 and 6, plus A3's gate 3/4 information.
Round 2: Gate 3 is confirmed safe left by A3; gate 4 is also reported safe left. Take both in sequence.
Round 3: Gate 5 is reported left by A4; gate 6 is known left. Take both safely in sequence.
Round 4: Gate 7 right is confirmed by A1, and gate 8 left is confirmed by A1. Take both in sequence to reach Bay E.
A3: Round 1: At gate 1, inspect surroundings first to learn the safe door before committing. Share my known information for gates 3 and 4.
Round 2: Gate 1 right is confirmed by A4 and A1; gate 2 left is confirmed by A2. Proceed safely through both.
Round 3: Gate 3 left and gate 4 left are known safe. Take both in sequence this round.
Round 4: Gate 5 left is confirmed by A4, and gate 6 left is confirmed by A2. Take both in sequence to reach Bay E.
A4: Round 1: Gate 1 is known safe right; gate 5 is known safe left. Share both facts and advance through gate 1.
Round 2: Gate 2 left is confirmed by A2; gate 3 left is reported by A3. Advance through both safe doors this round.
Round 3: Gate 4 left is confirmed by A3, and gate 5 left is known safe. Advance through both in sequence.
Round 4: Gate 6 left is confirmed by A2 and A3; gate 7 right is confirmed by A1. Advance through both in sequence.
